summary: Iteration 12 — Full test of: UnifiedPeoplePage checkboxes/bulk-select/edit, Children edit, WebAuthn backend endpoints, NFC dialog, Settings Security passkeys, Login passkey button. 21/21 backend tests passed. 2 frontend bugs found and fixed (NFC crash + Export TypeError). 1 UX bug reported (eye icon no-op).

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED: NFC Check-In dialog crashed with runtime error 'A <Select.Item /> must have a value prop that is not an empty string' because NFC event SelectItem had value='' — Fixed to value='_none' with proper handler
ui_bugs.priority: CRITICAL — was causing full page crash

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED: Export button called exportApi.membersCsv() which does not exist — TypeError caused 'Export failed' toast every time. Fixed to use exportApi.members() URL-based download

BUG REMAINING: Eye icon button (data-testid=edit-member-{id}) on member card calls openEditMember(m, e) which only pre-fills form state but does NOT set selectedMember, so the member detail dialog never opens. Eye icon click is effectively a no-op. Clicking the member card itself correctly opens dialog with Edit Profile tab.
ui_bugs.priority: MEDIUM — workaround: click card to open dialog, then Edit Profile tab

action_items: Fix eye icon (edit-member-{id}) on member card list: Call handleViewMember(m) instead of openEditMember(m, e) and auto-switch to 'Edit Profile' tab. Currently clicking eye does nothing visible (dialog doesn't open).
Optionally: Track defaultTab state in UnifiedPeoplePage to auto-switch to Edit Profile tab when eye icon clicked
critical_code_review_comments: CheckInsPage.jsx L344: <SelectItem value=''>No event</SelectItem> — Radix Select disallows empty string value, causes runtime crash. FIXED to value='_none'.

UnifiedPeoplePage.jsx L381: exportApi.membersCsv() — Method doesn't exist in api.js. exportApi only exposes URL strings (members, financial, events, ical), not axios calls. FIXED to use exportApi.members() with anchor-tag download.

UnifiedPeoplePage.jsx L478: Eye icon onClick={e => openEditMember(m, e)} — openEditMember sets editMember/editMemberForm state but never sets selectedMember, so the Member Detail Dialog (open={!!selectedMember}) does not open. Eye icon is a dead button.
UnifiedPeoplePage.jsx: Gender field in Edit Profile form shows 'Select' (not pre-filled) for members with no gender set — this is acceptable but shows blank data quality issue

webauthn.py register/complete L101: rp_id extracted from headers not body (body.get('rpId') not passed). Frontend sends rpId in registerComplete body. The _get_rp_id(request) (without body parameter) will try to derive from headers — may mismatch. Register/begin stores rp_id in challenge, register/complete uses stored rp_id, so this is actually OK.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests created TEST_EditChild (auto-cleaned up by fixture). No persistent test data created.
